title: Mia and Her Flashcards
text:
Mia has a box of flashcards. Each card has a word on one side. On the other side is a picture. Mia looks at the cards every day.

Today Mia studies with her friend Tom. Tom shows a card, and Mia reads the word. They have a lot of fun together.

questions.text: Why does Mia look at the cards every day?
options: She wants to learn new words
She is looking for lost cards

questions.text: How does Mia feel when she studies with Tom?

vocabulary.definition: a card with a word or picture to help you learn
a drawing or photo that you can look at
a person you know well and like
enjoyment, something that makes you happy

paragraph_translations: Mia ma pudełko z fiszkami. Na każdej karcie jest słowo. Po drugiej stronie jest obrazek. Mia patrzy na karty każdego dnia.
Dzisiaj Mia uczy się z przyjacielem Tomem. Tom pokazuje kartę, a Mia czyta słowo. Razem bawią się bardzo dobrze.
